title: berman.recipe/2
description: Versioned worker guidance for named connections (recipe.json), checked when a recipe is selected, after berman.recipes has judged its identity, coverage, recording protocol and the connection it is worded for. instructions and research_commission are then read as paths within the recipe's folder. connections is a list: given as text, a connection's name used to be looked for inside that text, so a recipe could match a connection it was not written for. Fields Berman only stores are not constrained.
